description: Implement actup-lsp: LSP server for GitHub Actions version checking with diagnostics and code actions

tasks.title: Create LSP skeleton with tower-lsp
tasks.description:
Set up the basic LSP server infrastructure. Done when:
- Cargo.toml has tower-lsp, dashmap, tokio, lsp-types dependencies
- LspBackend struct implements LanguageServer trait
- initialize/initialized/shutdown handlers work
- textDocumentSync and codeActionProvider capabilities declared
- Stdio transport entry point in main.rs
- Server starts and responds to initialize request

tasks.title: Implement document state management
tasks.description:
Track open documents for diagnostic computation. Done when:
- DashMap<Url, DocumentState> stores open documents
- DocumentState contains: text, version, cached diagnostics
- did_open stores document, did_close removes it
- did_change (FULL sync mode) updates stored text
- Files without 'uses:' keyword exit early (quiet mode)

tasks.title: Load actup config on workspace open
tasks.description:
Integrate with actup-core config system. Done when:
- On initialized, find workspace root from InitializeParams
- Call find_repo_config to load actup.toml
- Store resolved Config in backend state
- Config respects update_policy, ignore_actions, pin_to
- LSP initializationOptions can override config path

tasks.title: Set up provider registry and cache
tasks.description:
Initialize providers for version fetching. Done when:
- provider::Registry created with GitHub provider (feature-gated GitLab/Gitea)
- FileCache initialized at ~/.cache/actup/ (shared with CLI)
- CachingProvider wraps base provider for in-memory dedup
- Token loaded from GITHUB_TOKEN env var

tasks.title: Extract uses: refs and compute diagnostics
tasks.description:
Core diagnostic logic using actup-core. Done when:
- extract_uses_from_yaml parses document text
- parse_uses converts to ActionRef (skip local refs)
- check_action computes CheckStatus for each ref
- CheckStatus maps to LSP Diagnostic with correct severity:
  - Outdated -> Warning
  - Unresolvable (user) -> Error
  - Unresolvable (env) -> Information
  - Pinned -> Hint
- Diagnostic range points to ref portion after @

tasks.title: Publish diagnostics asynchronously
tasks.description:
Non-blocking diagnostic updates. Done when:
- did_open/did_save spawn background task for version checks
- Debounce mechanism (300ms) prevents API spam on rapid edits
- client.publish_diagnostics called when results ready
- Document version tracked to avoid stale updates
- Network errors don't block editor UI

tasks.title: Implement single-ref code actions
tasks.description:
Quick fixes for individual outdated refs. Done when:
- textDocument/codeAction handler implemented
- For Outdated diagnostic: returns 'Update to vX.Y.Z' action
- For Unresolvable with close match: returns 'Change to vX.Y.Z'
- CodeAction includes WorkspaceEdit with text replacement
- Edit replaces only the ref portion (preserves formatting)
- Diagnostic linked via CodeAction.diagnostics field

tasks.title: Add fix-all-in-file code action
tasks.description:
Bulk fix for current file. Done when:
- Source action with kind 'source.fixAll.actup' registered
- Aggregates all Outdated diagnostics in file
- Returns single WorkspaceEdit with all edits
- Appears in editor's 'Source Action' menu
- Edits applied atomically

tasks.title: Add fix-all-in-workspace command
tasks.description:
Workspace-wide bulk update. Done when:
- executeCommand 'actup.fixAllInWorkspace' registered
- Uses discover_files from actup-core to find all workflows
- Builds multi-file WorkspaceEdit
- Calls client.apply_edit to apply changes
- Progress reported via $/progress notifications
- Handles partial failures gracefully

tasks.title: Polish error user experience
tasks.description:
Better feedback for network/auth errors. Done when:
- Rate limit error shows window/showMessage notification
- Auth error suggests setting GITHUB_TOKEN
- Per-ref diagnostics show '(check failed: reason)'
- Aggregate status logged via MessageType::Log
- Errors don't spam user (deduplicated per-session)

tasks.title: Add unit tests for LSP logic
tasks.description:
Test diagnostic generation and code actions. Done when:
- Tests for CheckStatus -> Diagnostic severity mapping
- Tests for code action generation from diagnostics
- Tests for edit generation (preserves formatting)
- Tests for quiet mode (no uses: = no diagnostics)
- Mock provider responses, no network calls

tasks.title: Add integration tests with mock LSP client
tasks.description:
End-to-end LSP protocol tests. Done when:
- Test harness with mock LSP client
- Test: initialize -> didOpen -> diagnostics published
- Test: codeAction request returns expected fixes
- Test: executeCommand applies workspace edit
- Snapshot tests for YAML before/after edits

tasks.title: Add progress reporting for long operations
tasks.description:
User feedback during workspace-wide operations. Done when:
- $/progress notifications sent during workspace scan
- Shows 'Scanning N files...', 'Checking M actions...'
- Percentage progress during batch version fetches
- Cancellable via WorkDoneProgressCancelParams
- Progress token generated per-operation

tasks.title: Handle config file changes
tasks.description:
React to actup.toml modifications. Done when:
- Register watcher for **/actup.toml via workspace/didChangeWatchedFiles
- Re-load config when file changes
- Re-publish diagnostics for all open documents
- Handle workspace folder add/remove events
- Invalidate cached diagnostics on policy change

tasks.title: Add hover information for actions
tasks.description:
Show action details on hover. Done when:
- textDocument/hover handler implemented
- Hovering uses: line shows current + latest version
- Fetches action.yml description (cached)
- Includes link to action repository
- Shows deprecation warnings if input deprecated

tasks.title: Add completion for actions and versions
tasks.description:
Autocomplete for uses: values. Done when:
- textDocument/completion handler implemented
- After 'uses:' suggests popular actions (hardcoded + cached)
- After 'owner/repo@' suggests available versions
- CompletionItem includes description and documentation
- Trigger characters: '/', '@'
